title: The Japan Times highlights Burford's role in unlocking the value of Japanese patents
summary: The Japan Times highlights Burford's role in unlocking the value of Japanese patents. Learn more.
body_markdown:
*The Japan Times* features[Jonathan Molot](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/jonathan-molot/) and[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) in an article exploring how Japanese companies are increasingly seeking to monetize underutilized patent portfolios. The article highlights Burford's role in helping businesses unlock the value of their intellectual property while managing the costs and risks of patent litigation.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/business/2026/11/25/tech/patent-litigation-rising-japanese-companies/)
